home.intro: The Cui Mingjian Lab at the School of Electrical and Information Engineering, Tianjin University, focuses on renewable energy forecasting, power system optimal operation, and power system cyber security, with long-standing work on machine learning and deep learning for power systems.

highlights.title: Research Directions
highlights.desc: Four pillars: renewable energy forecasting, power system optimal operation, power system cyber security, and AI — tackling core scientific and engineering problems under high renewable penetration.

highlights.title: Recent Outputs
highlights.desc: Continuous papers in IEEE Transactions on Power Systems / Smart Grid / Sustainable Energy (Q1), with the PI listed among the World's Top 2% Scientists in 2023 and 2024.

highlights.title: Recruitment & Collaboration
highlights.desc: Actively recruiting master's and PhD students (3–4 per year) and undergraduate research interns; open to industry collaboration and joint training.
